formula: For fixed k, maximize mean_i(q_i) plus mean_ij(delta_tilde_ij), where delta_tilde is sign-preserving soft-thresholding of the full pair residual by lambda_mad*1.4826*MAD(delete-block estimates), then requires the selected sign in at least the support threshold fraction of jackknife estimates and applies pair_scale.
